atoms.b: Rebecca and her family recently moved to Manchester from Bristol. Although the Manchester Giants are a ((++tremendous)) team, her favourite basketball team is still the Bristol Bulls. Besides being a basketball fan, she is also a basketball player herself. Some of her new teammates are ((++antagonistic)) to Rebecca because in their eyes she supports the wrong team. Rebecca’s parents knew that it would be difficult for her to arrive in her new school as she always struggled to make new friends. Nevertheless, her parents took a ((++calculated)) risk and made sure that Rebecca could join the school’s basketball team as soon as possible. The basketball team had a reputation for being very ((++ambitious)). They were best known for their creative play and for never ((++squandering)) their opportunities to score points.

atoms.b: Besides being a basketball player, Rebecca is an enthusiastic gamer. One day, she had the idea to stop playing basketball and to focus on becoming a world-class gamer. She told her parents that, while her development in basketball was ((++stagnant)), her gaming skills were ((++consistently)) improving. Rebecca’s parents were not enthusiastic about their daughter’s ((++preposterous)) plan. Besides the fact that Rebecca would not have as much physical exercise any more, they researched the ((++approximate)) cost of a gaming computer, which is a lot higher than the necessary equipment for playing basketball. Rebecca was disappointed that her parents didn’t support her plans, but that didn’t mean that she gave up on her dreams.
